editorial: For this city-and-shrine route, spring or autumn are the obvious starting points. Spring brings cherry blossoms; autumn brings cooler walking weather and foliage, with the timing varying by region. Neither comes with a crowd-free guarantee.

We travelled in late September and early October. There were cloudy days in Tokyo, relentless rain in Kyoto, and a beautifully clear day in Hiroshima. Rain made Gion cinematic and Kinkaku-ji atmospheric, but also forced us to abandon part of the itinerary.

October is a sensible default if comfortable weather matters more than chasing blossoms. Don't assume late September means autumn colours in every city, and keep some flexibility for rain and possible typhoon disruption.
